profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: Computer Science graduate from the University of Texas at Arlington with 7 years of industry experience as a full-stack software engineer. Experienced in building and maintaining scalable applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, React, Node.js, MongoDB, and SQL.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Full-stack developer on the Loan Origination and Servicing teams, owning core payment systems, automation pipelines, and APIs supporting large-scale loan operations, including a high-traffic loan payment platform processing $48M+ per month. Focused on reliability, performance, and developer quality across the stack.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Software Developer on the Global Mortgages & Securitized Products Risk team, building an internal risk analytics platform used by traders to assess bonds and mortgage-backed securities. Developed frontend features with React and Redux and supported backend services in Python.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description: Diagnosed hardware and software issues and performed device repairs for customers at the Apple Store.
